items.title: بعد الأساسيات لا تحتاج لدراسة كل فروع Cyber Security بنفس العمق.

Build a small network in Packet Tracer.
Automate simple administration tasks with Bash.
Analyze educational PCAP files with Wireshark.
Identify DNS, TCP, HTTP and TLS traffic.
Use OWASP Juice Shop or PortSwigger labs.
